book.generated_mod.entry.gluttony_sin.pa: Some relics are not discovered; they seek out those who can bear them. The Sin of Gluttony is among the most dangerous: it forges hunger into power and carves the price into its bearer's soul.

Wear the Sin of Gluttony in the Curios sin slot while bearing the Ring of Seven Curses to awaken its devouring power. Use the Devour key on a creature with less health than you; it defaults to empty-hand right-click and allows held items after rebinding. The first devouring of each species permanently increases maximum health and attack; later devourings only restore health. Every devouring consumes hunger and triggers Gluttony, while the normal form also has a cooldown.

The Creative Sin of Gluttony requires no Ring of Seven Curses and carries no curses or cooldown. It retains the core power of devouring growth, making it suitable for studying the relic's full effect in Creative mode. Both variants support vanilla and modded creatures.

The Sin of Gluttony records every creature species devoured and saves the growth to the player. Hold Shift to view accumulated growth, or Alt to view curses and reversal conditions. With Enigmatic Delicacy installed, wearing the Endless Gluttony Badge also unlocks cooldown-free area vacuum devouring.
